inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pad hot-stick use area (access door side) lacks minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure
inputs.question: For each transformer pad shown on Sheet 21, which side faces the access door (identify door orientation)? Are access doors facing open areas or buildings? Can the 10-foot clearance requirement be verified for the hot-stick use area on the access door side?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking for feature identification and orientation assessment (which side has the access door, what it faces) as a prerequisite to later measurement; this is a presence/orientation check, not yet a clearance measurement itself.
